ability.name: Step 2 - Confirm Nmap presence
ability.description: Prove nmap is on PATH or register absence to trigger fallbacks.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $nmapPath = Get-Command nmap -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($nmapPath) { $v = nmap --version 2>&1 | Select-String "Nmap version"; Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true"; Write-Output "NMAP_VERSION: $v" } else { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step2.txt

rationale: Verifies if the Nmap scanning utility is pre-installed so the playbook can choose the quietest available engine.
